pos.personaBrief: No verified 1980 evidence (gap axis); from general knowledge and the unverified Coutinho-era note that failed wing moves were recycled back to the defence to restart on the other side, the Zico-Junior-Andrade side was a technical, ball-dominant team.

pro.personaBrief: The verified decisive goal of the 1980 final came from a rehearsed long pass by Andrade to Nunes, but that is a single move; the Coutinho-era habit of recirculating the ball suggests patient short build-up was the norm, with the vertical pass used when the striker was free.

est.personaBrief: Coutinho's rehearsed 'jogadas ensaiadas' and drilled fundamentals point to defined patterns, while his call for 'participacao total... quase como no basquete' and players projecting into the box (verified) point to fluid, close combinations around Zico, with Tita moving inside.

lar.personaBrief: No verified 1980 width evidence (gap axis); from general knowledge the play ran through Zico in the centre with Tita as an inside forward and Junior's overlaps providing width, consistent with the 4-3-3/4-5-1 lineup in the verified final.

blo.personaBrief: No verified 1980 pressing evidence (gap axis); general knowledge and unverified era notes (team 'pressionava o adversario sem a bola', compact high lines) suggest a high, aggressive block, while verified training emphasis on rehearsed moves means those were valued as much as high regains.

mar.personaBrief: No verified 1980 marking evidence (gap axis); from general knowledge and the unverified note that Coutinho introduced 'marcacao por setor' at Flamengo, the team defended zonally rather than man-to-man.

pla.personaBrief: Coutinho studied Atletico-MG's system before the final (verified) but did not change his own; his innovator stance ('algum clube comece a atuar de uma forma mais moderna') and daily drilling of his model point to own identity first.

res.personaBrief: The 1980 side scored 46 goals in 22 Brasileiro games and won the final 3-2 attacking (verified); Coutinho, of 'campeao moral' fame, valued playing well, though the team also chased titles hard.

sis.personaBrief: Coutinho's drilled, scientific collective ('participacao total' for 90 minutes, rehearsed plays) framed a team of stars led by Zico (21 goals, verified), so both system duties and the star's decisive role coexist.

jog.personaBrief: No verified player-profile evidence (gap axis); from general knowledge the side was built on technique (Zico, Junior, Andrade, Adilio), with Coutinho's physical-preparation background and demand for 90-minute participation adding intensity as a requirement.

bas.personaBrief: Verified: Coutinho 'pegou aquela molecada' committed to the club and mixed it with veterans like Raul, Toninho and Carpegiani, plus targeted signings like Nunes; the academy core (Zico, Junior, Andrade, Tita) was central to winning the title.

lid.personaBrief: Coutinho brought 'profissionalismo' and military rigour, yet was noted (1976, outside period) for open dialogue with players; the late-1980 crisis blamed on 'autossuficiencia' hints at a group of strong personalities he managed with both rules and conversation.
